## What this lane did

I re-derived Fleissner's §5–§7 from scratch, then re-read the disputed displays on printed pp. 369–371 **from the 600‑dpi embedded page images by connected‑component glyph extraction** (not the OCR layer), and compared both published presentations (Trans. AMS **273** (1982) 365–373 and the PNAS **79** (1982) 1371–1372 announcement, retrieved via PMC345971). The mandated output and full evidence trail are in `research/phase-2-remaining-27-step3b-pair-normal-moore-spaces-pmea-and-consistency-strength.md` (rewritten; the 2026-09-16 item record preserved as Appendix A).

## Result: the seven items are re-escalated, on a sharper and partly *confirmed* diagnosis

- **Confirmed**: the notation sentence after (12) is printed `(we will use Σ^{ρ|m} for Σ^{(ρ|m)*})` (verified glyph-by-glyph: `(`, ρ, straight bar `|`, m, `)`, `*`), and (17) is printed `Z(ρ,δ) = Z(τ,η) ∩ Σ^{ρ|m}` (glyphs verified: `∩`, `Σ` matched to the chain's own Σ at distance 0.019, raised exponent `ρ|m`). Under the paper's own notation, `Σ^{ρ|m} = Σ^{ρ(m-1)}`, so the printed **(18a)** clause `ρ|m ∈ Z(ρ,δ)` (membership glyph `∈` and the set `Z(ρ,δ)` verified) is **impossible** — (17) and (18a) are jointly inconsistent. Hence the Erdős–Rado-homogeneous alternative can only ever be (18b).
- **The single missing implication, named exactly**: (18b) plus the printed chain cannot contradict; transferring any verdict about the middle sequence `σ|m` from `Z(σ,δ)` to `Z(σ,η)` needs **`σ|m ∈ Σ^{ρ|m}`**, which is false because `σ(m-1) > ρ(m-1)` by the interleaving (8)/Lemma 3(c).
- **Verified repair route (not yet complete)**: read the exponent bound strictly above `σ(m-1)` (the ordinal reading `Σ^{ρ(m)}`, equivalently the restriction `ρ|(m+1)`) in (12), (17) and the chain — then the chain nests, `σ|m ∈ Σ^{ρ(m)}`, both (18a)/(18b) close, and (17)+(18) is a *sufficient* conflict witness. The one unverified ingredient is the **production** of such witnesses for every pair of the stafull set; disjointness gives only unsatisfiability. Three unverified leads are recorded in §3b of the report (the n=1 self-contradiction; a `{(x(0))}` witness scheme requiring a special global listing; and the coverage step `⋃{[σ] : σ ∈ B-σ ⊆ U} = F`, which the printed text does not prove and which I could not settle).
